lastReview: Full chromium-mock sweep, 112 tests, --workers=1 --retries=0: 65 passed, 18 failed, 25 skipped, 4 not run. All nine entries below were re-run tonight and all nine still fail on their own merits, so the list is unchanged. The other nine failures are NOT listed here and must not be added: they are one broken precondition, not nine defects. The dev API on :8000 is running INFERENCE_MODE=ollama with gemma3:1b, a text-only model, so every POST /infer answers 500 'this model is missing data required for image input' and no detection can ever reach the store. Every spec that waits on one therefore times out — mock-export-outcome (4), mock-session-reload (3), mock-pin-edit (1), mock-xr8-scan (1). Those specs' headers all name INFERENCE_MODE=mock as a requirement; restarting the API that way fixes all nine at once. tests/support/inference-engine.ts now probes /infer from each of those specs so the failure arrives in about a second, naming the engine, instead of after 45-60 s of blind polling (measured: those nine went from ~12 minutes to ~13 seconds). The 25 skips are the pre-existing fixture gates — splat-fixture, lingbot-map, and the API_URL-only tests. 2026-11-23, wave 14 ticket 0005 (editor): the six mock-rtc-* entries are removed. They failed because the live feed is opt-in (src/rtc/feature.ts, VITE_ENABLE_WEBRTC_LIVE) and the default dev server leaves it off, so the Live button never shows and no broadcaster starts. The specs now skip by name when the build has it off: re-run against a dev server started from this branch with the flag unset, --workers=1 --retries=0: 6 skipped. They have NOT been run with the flag on, which also needs the API's /rtc-signal. '07 render modes' stays listed: its spec now drives the Views menu's #view-mode-select instead of the removed #mode-* buttons (FN-054, FN-089), but it needs a seeded default world and was not re-run. tests/mock-xr-world.spec.ts was re-run (3 passed). mock-ui-desktop, e2e-suite, mock-editor-homes and mock-editor-quality were edited and not run.
